decisions.reason: The source proposes copy for a mint-result modal and does not change landing-page content or layout.
The modal-specific no-referral message does not revise the About page or resolve its prize-payout-copy ambiguity.
The source describes the existing $12 random no-referral commission in proposed modal copy; it does not necessarily change the commission amount, trigger, or weighted recipient-selection rule.
The client limits the proposed wording to the modal and does not request any FAQ revision.
Random assignment of a no-referral draw ticket is distinct from how a prize winner receives or claims a payout.
The source proposes user-facing modal copy and does not explicitly revise the number of tickets generated, eligible mint coverage, or recipient-selection mechanics.
Mentioning the book title in modal copy does not change the landing-page cover's presence, placement, size, or cropping.
The $12 figure describes a commission in the no-referral modal and does not revise the general $30 mint revenue allocation or prize-pool destination.
The source concerns no-referral result feedback and does not alter optional-tip behavior or its follow-up transaction notice.
The modal copy does not change whether or how a connected wallet completes a USDC mint.
The source does not mention Transak, fiat conversion, wallet provisioning, or any change to the deferred fiat-mint flow.
The proposed modal text does not change which NFT metadata attributes are exposed or their source of truth.
